newsitem.title: CANADA: ICAO appoints Brazil official Secretary-General.
newsitem.headline: ICAO appoints Brazil official Secretary-General.

text.p: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) said on Wednesday that its Council appointed Renato Claudio Costa Pereira as new Secretary General of the U.N. agency for a three-year term.
Pereira is currently president of CERNAI, the Brazilian government agency responsible for international air navigation affairs. Pereira will succeed Philippe Rochat, of Switzerland, on August 1.
ICAO was also expected to appoint this week a new president, replacing Assad Kotaite.

ICAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations. It sets international standards and regulations for the safety, security, efficiency and regularity of air transport and is the medium for cooperation in civil aviation among its 185 contracting states.
